 Trisha Easto USA TODAY Updated Oct. 28, 2026, 12:36 a.m. ET Hear this story The Tampa Bay Rays defeated the Milwaukee Brewers in Game 4 to avoid a sweep in the 2026 World Series.
 The series now stands at 3-1, with the Brewers leading the Rays.
 Games 5 will be held at Tropicana Field in St. Petersburg, Florida.
 Tickets for Game 5 in Tampa Bay are still available and significantly less expensive than those for potential game 6 in Milwaukee.
 ]There will be a Game 5! If you thought the 2026 World Series was headed for a sweep, the Tampa Bay Rays said not so fast.
 With a 4-3 extra-inning win over the Milwaukee Brewers , the Rays are finally on the board. The game was tied 2-2 heading into extra innings, and after Cooper Pratt's home run in the top of the 12th, Jonny DeLuca tied it again at 3-3 in the bottom of the 12th before Ben Williamson played pinch hit hero with a walk-off single, keeping Tampa Bay's season alive.
 The series now stands at 3-1 with just one more game scheduled for Tropicana Field in Florida on Wednesday night.

Tickets for the Brewers home World Series games have been off the charts, with prices starting close to $2,500 . If you're getting in, it's much cheaper to attend games at the Trop.
